verdict.rationale: The docs describe two update paths. For copied files, the explicit `npx skills update` command pulls the latest changes on demand. For the plugin route, the official marketplace install self-updates, with Claude Code updating by default and Codex updating at startup. The runtime probe confirmed the install path works but never ran an update. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that `npx skills update` and the plugin auto-update actually deliver fixes.
